gen-gf-offside-gf-spline-sans-mono: Wide-spaced and unfinished-looking curves give Offside a bold, deliberate stance. And Spline Sans Mono follows in fixed-width, code-style letters, with bold strokes that never thicken or thin, so the two feel built from different machines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-tiny5: Commanding and expressive, Offside draws its arches and stems at a single thickness, with curves that never quite close. But Tiny5 does the quiet work underneath, a tall body whose ascenders look short and approachable.
gen-gf-offside-gf-truculenta: Offside stretches out wide, its curves left open and its beat level. Truculenta can take a modest size, since its compact, crowded lines and tall x-height keep the plain sans text readable without any enlarging.
gen-gf-offside-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu brings a lofty lowercase band to the page, modern and businesslike in its manner. Yet the strongest thing here is the gap between it and Offside, whose widely tracked line feels drawn with a ruler and compass.
gen-gf-offside-gf-victor-mono: Structured and precise, Victor Mono spaces its glyphs loosely and leaves its bowls open on one side. Yet Offside is the one that commands, with wide tracking and curves that refuse to close, while the monospace simply holds the text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-viga: Viga keeps its capitals barely taller than the neighboring letters, with no hairlines or shadows anywhere in its strokes. Beneath Offside's widely spaced, open-curved heading, a longer stretch of it reads smooth and unfussy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-voces: Offside sets its curves open and tracks them wide, with no visible difference between its upright and sideways strokes. Voces, a plain sans with tall lowercase and a middling thick-thin ratio, reads steadily across a long page.
gen-gf-offside-gf-winky-rough: Tubular, wire-like letterforms mark Offside as expressive from the first glance. Winky Rough, a sans-serif with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, keeps a long passage contemporary and businesslike.
gen-gf-offside-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase, modern and plain. Offside, meanwhile, draws a line that never swells or tapers, so its widely tracked, open-curved heading sits above that sans-serif like a bold, level signature.
gen-gf-offside-gf-yantramanav: Rolling-ball-pen lines, single in width, sweep across Offside's widely tracked heading, with curves that never quite close. Yantramanav answers with huddled, tall lowercase and spacious terminal gaps, which is the strongest thing about this pair.
